d.why: On screen in seven Iron Fist S1 episodes (1, 2, 4-7 and 13) as Danny's assistant at Rand.
On screen in Iron Fist S1 episodes 7-9 as the Hand's captive chemist and Sabina's father.

Only on screen in Iron Fist S1 episode 3 (mentioned in episode 4), where he sells his pier to the Meachums in a side plot while the episode is about Danny at Birch; his nephew Terence is not one of the family ties the rule keeps.
On screen in two Iron Fist S1 episodes (Under Leaf Pluck Lotus and The Mistress of All Agonies) as the Rand chemist who helps Danny.
On screen in Iron Fist S1 episodes 1 and 3 as the Rand guard who throws Danny out and later ambushes him.
On screen only in Iron Fist S2 episode 1 (mentioned in 8 and 9), but he is Danny Rand's employer at Royal Al Moving, a boss tie the rule keeps.
On screen in Iron Fist S2 episodes 3 and 5-9 (corpse in 10) as the Golden Tigers leader allied with Davos.
On screen in three Iron Fist S2 episodes (Heart of the Dragon, Citadel on the Edge of Vengeance, War Without End) as Davos's disciple.

Only on screen in Iron Fist S2 episode 9 (mentioned elsewhere), where as an informant he tells Colleen the story behind her box, a witness role in her story; his cousin Henry Yip is not a family tie the rule keeps.
On screen in Iron Fist S2 episodes 1 and 9, extorted by Ryhno's gang and later killed by Davos.
On screen in three Iron Fist S2 episodes (Target: Iron Fist, Citadel on the Edge of Vengeance, War Without End) as a Hatchet loyal to Sherry Yang.
On screen in Iron Fist S2 episodes 7 and 8 (The City's Not for Burning, Morning of the Mindstorm), blackmailed over the Erskine bowl.
On screen in Iron Fist S2 episodes 1, 2, 5, 7 and 8 as the leader of his gang who follows Davos.
On screen in Iron Fist S2 episodes 2 and 8-10 as Colleen's friend at Bayard.
On screen in Iron Fist S2 episodes 2-4, 6 and 8-10 as the Hatchets' new leader.
On screen in Ironheart episodes 1-5 (flashbacks in 6) as a member of the Hood's gang.
Only on screen in Ironheart episode 1, where as MIT's dean she expels Riri in one scene that sets Riri's story going; she has no family or boss tie to anyone with a file.
Only on screen in Ironheart episode 3, but he is the target of the Heirlum heist the episode is about and is strangled by the Hood.
On screen in Ironheart episodes 1-3 (plus flashbacks in 4 and 6) as the Hood's cousin who recruits Riri.

Only on screen in Ironheart episode 1 (voice on a voicemail in 2, photo or mention in 3-5), where he botches a heist and watches Riri's test as a minor gang member; his murder happens off screen and he has no family or boss tie the rule keeps.
On screen in Ironheart episodes 1-5 (flashbacks in 6) as a member of the Hood's gang.
Only on screen in Ironheart episode 2, but she is the target of the TNNL tunnel heist the episode is about, cornered by the Hood until she signs his contract.
On screen in Ironheart episodes 1-5 (flashbacks in 6) as the Hood's gang's hacker.
On screen in Jessica Jones S1 episodes 9, 10, 12 and 13 (footage in 8) as Kilgrave's father.
Only on screen in Jessica Jones S1 episode 4, but she is the episode's antagonist, using a fake cheating case to lure Jessica into a trap and shoot her; she is also Carlo Eastman's wife.
Only on screen in Jessica Jones S1 episode 1 (mentioned later), but she is the client whose missing-daughter case the episode is about, and the mother of Hope Shlottman, who has a file.
Only on screen in Jessica Jones S1 episode 1 (mentioned later), but he is the client whose missing-daughter case the episode is about, and the father of Hope Shlottman, who has a file.
Only on screen in Jessica Jones S1 episode 4, playing the fake cheating husband in Audrey's trap, but he is the husband of Audrey Eastman, who has a file, a spouse tie the rule keeps.
Only on screen in Jessica Jones S1 episode 6 (mentioned in 2), but he is the man Luke is hunting as Reva's killer, and the episode builds to Luke's attack on him and Jessica's confession.
On screen in Jessica Jones S1 episodes 4, 6, 9 and 10 as a Kilgrave survivor in the support group.
